question: What was the trading volume and price change percentage for Ethereum (ETH)?

truths.label: vol_and_chg
truths.source: written in the frame the node's own leaked probe uses, with our live figures substituted
truths.text: Ethereum (ETH) had a 24 hour trading volume of ${vol_m:.2f} million and a price change of {chg:.2f}% over the same period.

truths.label: vol_chg_price
truths.source: written: the same frame with the price added, which a model reading a market page would include
truths.text: Ethereum (ETH) traded ${vol_m:.2f} million over 24 hours at a price of ${price:,.2f}, a change of {chg:.2f}%.

truths.label: vol_only
truths.source: written: a model answering only the volume half
truths.text: Ethereum's 24 hour trading volume was ${vol_m:.1f} million.

truths.label: chg_only
truths.source: written: a model answering only the change half
truths.text: Ethereum's price changed by {chg:.2f}% over the past 24 hours.

truths.label: coarse
truths.source: written: a model rounding both figures as reporting does
truths.text: Ethereum (ETH) saw roughly ${vol_m:.0f} million of volume and moved about {chg:.1f}% in the last day.
